{"id":2031193625,"question_id":342,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 1 week","timestamp":1781296284,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2031193625/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Power of Four","memory":"7.9 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int BinaryConversion(int n)\n    {\n        int nullbit = 0;\n        while(n > 0)\n        {\n            if(n % 2 == 0) nullbit++;\n            n /= 2;\n        }\n        return nullbit;\n    }\n\n    bool isPowerOfFour(int n) {\n        if(n == 1) return true;\n        if(n & 1) return false;\n        if(n == INT_MIN) return false;\n\n        int setbit = __builtin_popcount(n);\n        int nullbits = BinaryConversion(n);\n\n        if(setbit == 1)\n        {\n            if(nullbits % 2 == 0) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"power-of-four","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2097}
